title: Dedup — heap count-window (compute.dedup.first / .duplicates)
description: Fingerprint dedup, heap count-window (DEC-054, 2026-09-03): plain operator-local per-token windows, no managed state. Earlier designs (DEC-038 Fluss KV store; DEC-040 Flink keyed MapState + native TTL, 2026-08-17) are retired with native StateTtlConfig (DEDUP_TTL_MS=60000, ProcessingTime, OnCreateAndWrite). No Fluss dedup table, no cache, no cleanup backlog, no rehydration (the DEC-038 Fluss store is removed). Counters (the only exported metrics): compute.dedup.first (accepted), compute.dedup.duplicates (dropped). The former gauges compute.dedup.state.count (live entries, TTL-resynced) and compute.dedup.state.bytes.estimate (RocksDB) NO LONGER EXIST — they went with the 2026-08-28 rename that turned the state-count gauge into a cumulative firsts counter, so FingerprintDedupFunction now registers exactly the two counters above and the live-entry count survives only as its internal G-DEDUP-2 guard (totalEntries). The two panels that measured live-set size were removed 2026-09-17 by the compute-identifier parity sweep (CHG-195) because they rendered empty; read state growth from compute.dedup.first and the checkpoint-size tile on the Compute dashboard. Source: FingerprintDedupFunction -> flink-metrics-otel -> otel-collector:4318 -> metrics.

panels.title: Accepted first-seen rate — compute.dedup.first
panels.description: Delta of first-seen acceptances (new fingerprints admitted). Rate = live-set growth rate; steady-state should equal new-fingerprint arrival.

queries.query: SELECT rate(value) as y, _timestamp as x FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='flink_taskmanager_job_task_operator_compute_dedup_first' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x

panels.title: Duplicate drop rate — compute.dedup.duplicates
panels.description: Delta of dropped duplicates (re-arrivals within TTL). Expected ≈ re-delivery rate; a spike signals replay or a re-connect storm.

queries.query: SELECT rate(value) as y, _timestamp as x FROM metrics WHERE metric_name='flink_taskmanager_job_task_operator_compute_dedup_duplicates' GROUP BY x ORDER BY x
